# Official Poppy 0.4 test kit fixtures

Unmodified files from personal-agent-protocol/personal-agent-protocol commit
`53fcb21a647d841763b1608c959c52ceaa5387b8` (last kit revision before the 1.0 draft).
Source: https://github.com/personal-agent-protocol/personal-agent-protocol/tree/53fcb21a647d841763b1608c959c52ceaa5387b8/kit/company

`jose.ts` and `schema.ts` come from `validate/`; JSON files are the schemas exercised by the tests and their references, from `schemas/`.
Apache-2.0; license included. SHA256.json records original bytes. Do not format or
modify these fixtures to make a test pass. Update the pin and review upstream changes instead.
These are independent test inputs, not a claim of official certification.
